prompt: Write 10 distinct lessons the claims-triage agent (home and motor claims assessment within delegated authority) at Larkmere Mutual learned across many cases about: flood defences and the premium. Each is a working pattern or tip for the next case, not about any one member, one or two sentences, in the agent's voice ("When…, …"). Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 2)
response: {"items":[{"type":"observation","content":"When a home has permanent flood defences, I note whether they are maintained and usable today, because a barrier that cannot be deployed quickly is area altogether."},{"type":"preference","content":"When a claim mentions temporary flood defences, I prefer to record how quickly they can be installed and by whom, because a defence that needs
